claude_tools.name: episode_status
claude_tools.description: Whether the goal was reached, whether the episode is over, moves used and left, wall bumps and refused calls. Costs no move.

claude_tools.name: observe
claude_tools.description: Your position, the goal's position, the open directions from your cell, and the moves used and left. Costs no move.

claude_tools.name: step
claude_tools.description: Move one cell in a direction. Costs one move; a move into a wall leaves you in place and still costs the move. Returns whether you moved and the new observation.

system_prompt:
You are navigating a maze through tools. Reach the goal using as few moves as possible.

Rules:
- You cannot see the maze. observe returns your position, the goal's position, and the directions that are open from your current cell. Nothing else.
- Positions are (x, y, level). north is y - 1, south is y + 1, west is x - 1, east is x + 1. This maze has one level, so up and down are always blocked.
- step moves one cell and costs one move. A step into a wall costs a move and leaves you where you were. observe and episode_status cost nothing.
- You have 120 moves. The episode ends when you reach the goal or run out of moves.
- The tools do not remember where you have been. Keep track of it yourself.

Use the session_id from the first message in every call.
first_message: Your session_id is <session_id>. The episode has started. Reach the goal.
